refs.title: Pajama cardinal fish Sphaeramia nematoptera (cropped).jpg
refs.author: see Commons page (file credit)
refs.note: Working copy: photo mirrored left-right (the fish faces left) and rotated 11.8 deg counter-clockwise about (507, 350) so snout and peduncle centre sit level (the fish is pitched nose-down). All px below are in that mirrored, levelled 1920x791 copy. By-eye annotation, about +-15 px; tail rear and the fin trailing edges are the least certain. Second photo p6 (Sphaeramia nematoptera Marinepia.jpg, CC BY-SA 4.0, close-up) read for the spot and band pattern only.

frame.note: px -> card: u = (x - xTail)/W, v = (y - yAxis)/W, W = xSnout - xTail (total length).

thickness.note: No front or top photo and no cited figure; the existing 0.4 is kept, 3D front and top views are NOT claimed validated. The pectoral fin is hidden in the photo and is not drawn.

look.note: Colours carried from the previous plan, retuned by eye to the photo. Dorsal, anal and tail colour come from pajamacardinal.grid.json (scripts/fingrid.py).

barPaths.note: the black scale-net band behind the gill cover, as a body-relative ribbon (photo px [x, y, width])
